name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may be submitted
by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 9, 2023
  5:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and submit
it to the City Clerk prior to the commencement of the meeting. Any public comments that
cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. Under
California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda
only. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is prohibited from taking action
on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to staff or to a
subsequent meeting.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
The City Council will recess to closed session to discuss the following items:

  1. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL-ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Initiation of litigation pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(d)(4)
  Number of potential cases: 1

  2. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL-ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to Government Code section
  54956.9(d)(2)
  Number of potential cases: 1

  3. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957
  Title: City Manager

  4. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957.6
  Agency Designated Negotiators: Mayor
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager
 RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
